960	He brings their names: Eliezer gave them names.	Ele traz os nomes deles: Eliézer lhes deu nomes.
961	To Shakra he called Shakra.	A Shakra chamou Shakra.

963	And all the people of Sodom and Amorah made beds, by the word of the four judges, built in the city street.	E todos os homens de Sodoma e Amorá fizeram camas, pela palavra dos quatro juízes, construídas na rua da cidade.
964	And anyone who came and went to these cities, they stood over him, seized him, and brought him to one of the beds,	E todo aquele que ia e vinha a essas cidades, eles o cercavam, o agarravam e o levavam a uma das camas,

970	so shall be done to the man who comes into our land. And all the people stopped coming to them,	assim será feito ao homem que vier à nossa terra. E todos deixaram de ir até eles,

978	Kill him with a cruel death.	Matá-lo com uma morte cruel.
979	Cruelty, writes the Malbim, was part of their system.	A crueldade, escreve o Malbim, era parte do sistema deles.
980	To be cruel, that was their trait.	Ser cruel era o traço deles.
981	Like we found with Nebuchadnezzar, who ate a rabbit.	Como encontramos com Nabucodonosor, que comeu um coelho.
982	Why did he eat a rabbit?	Por que ele comeu um coelho?
983	For what?	Para quê?

986	The Midrash continues and says: every poor man who came, it was permitted for anyone to strip him	O Midrash continua e diz: todo pobre que chegava, era permitido a qualquer um despi-lo
